# Official sources and access ledger

## Follow-up acquisition: 19 October 2026

Actual files, hashes and failed requests are now documented in
[data_availability.md](data_availability.md), [dataset_inventory.csv](dataset_inventory.csv)
and [acquisition_results.json](acquisition_results.json). Primary endpoints used:
[SRA GIS-MIS](https://sra.gov.in/details/sub-category/gis-mis-slum-data),
[SRA MapServer](https://umd.nic.in/sramap/rest/services/SRA/SRAMumbai/MapServer),
[SRA FeatureServer layers](https://umd.nic.in/sramap/rest/services/SRA/SRAMumbai/FeatureServer/layers),
[SRA 2024 map](https://media.sra.gov.in/sra-automation/category/docs/1731408978437_4524_slum_cluster_ca_2024%20%281%29.pdf),
[public scheme listing](https://dms.sra.gov.in/SRAPUBLIC/),
[OGD catalogue](https://www.data.gov.in/catalog/slum-rehabilitation-authority-brihanmumbai),
[Geofabrik](https://download.geofabrik.de/asia/india.html) and
[official OSM bounding-box API](https://www.openstreetmap.org/api/0.6/map?bbox=72.9,19.04,72.94,19.08).
OSM reuse attribution: [OpenStreetMap copyright / ODbL](https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright).

The four requested numerical Census assets were acquired after repairing the
server's missing intermediate certificate using verified public CA material without
disabling TLS or hostname checks: [PCA SLUM XLS](https://censusindia.gov.in/nada/index.php/catalog/6190/download/9267/slum_data_census_2011.xls),
[housing HH-1](https://censusindia.gov.in/nada/index.php/catalog/11436/download/14549/SHH0101-crc.pdf),
[household amenities HH-11](https://censusindia.gov.in/nada/index.php/catalog/11448/download/14561/SHH3711-crc.pdf)
and [water HH-6](https://censusindia.gov.in/nada/index.php/catalog/11443/download/14556/SHH2206-crc.pdf).
The source water filename is recorded exactly in [Census acquisition details](census_followup.md)
and the inventory; all observations remain 2011 at their original geographic level.
[Dataful](https://dataful.in/datasets/272/) remains a convenience metadata source only.
The [official 2024 register](https://media.sra.gov.in/sra-automation/sra-website/content/1731566774802_3204_Slum%20Cluster%202024.pdf)
adds 2,597 rows and exact map-ID links. The existing map is a georeferenced raster,
not a feature export. [Scheme pagination](sra_projects_followup.md) reached all 228
advertised public pages with 5,677 rows, unknown current status and no cluster join.

The older dated access ledger below retains its original observations. It is
superseded for the four acquired Census assets and the SRA follow-up described above;
other unacquired assets such as catalogue 11441 remain separately unverified.
For the optional collection proposal, official [Kobo export documentation](https://support.kobotoolbox.org/export_download.html)
and [ODK form management](https://docs.getodk.org/central-forms/) were inspected.
These are not sources of existing service observations.

## Earlier ledger, retained with its original date

All access attempts below: **2026-10-17**. Publication dates and underlying observation dates are separate. A failed research-tool fetch is not a finding that a government portal is globally unavailable. No authenticated functions were exercised.

## Primary nonprofit alternatives and a secondary data lead

- **N01:** [Shelter Associates](https://shelter-associates.org/) and [2024–25 annual report](https://shelter-associates.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/Annual-Report-24-25-05.11.25.pdf). Organisation-authored evidence of household/settlement mapping, sanitation delivery, digital addressing and resident participation. Public descriptions do not establish permission to download their household data or independent verification of every claimed outcome.
- **N02:** [SNEHA resources](https://www.snehamumbai.org/resources/). Primary organisation source for existing health/Anganwadi scorecards. See Osrin et al. in the literature review for an evaluated settlement-vulnerability scorecard.
- **N03:** [Pune Slums Data on OpenCity](https://data.opencity.in/dataset/pune-slums-data). Search index identifies CSV/PDF and PMC as publisher, with an aggregator “Other (Public Domain)” tag. Direct request returned 403. Original table date, columns, geometry and underlying reuse authorisation are not established. Do not treat the aggregator tag as confirmed government permission.
- **N04, secondary spatial references:** Mapcarta's OSM-derived [Govandi station](https://mapcarta.com/N3205733664), [Bainganwadi bus stop](https://mapcarta.com/N3439107263) and [Shivaji Nagar Bus Depot](https://mapcarta.com/W395230147) records were readable. Three named coordinates were transcribed for reference display, with unknown observation dates and unverified entrances/operation. No images, tiles or road geometry were copied. See [access_followup.md](access_followup.md) and D32 for provenance and ODbL attribution.

## Failed downloads and access boundary

1. Local Python `urllib` request for the BMC FY2025–26 climate-budget PDF failed before HTTP with `socket.gaierror: [Errno -3] Temporary failure in name resolution`. No source file was saved. Later web-tool requests to the PDF also failed; indexed excerpts were visible.
2. BMC climate/vulnerability PDFs, Pune open-data root, Bhuvan root, SRA GIS/ArcGIS and several Census paths failed through the research tool. Some have indexed metadata; those are explicitly marked INDEX_ONLY above.
3. WorldPop legacy REST query `https://www.worldpop.org/rest/data/pop/wpgp?iso3=IND` and `https://hub.worldpop.org/geodata/summary?id=6529` failed. The numeric summary ID was not accepted as a verified India product. Use the current catalogue to select a product.
4. [Google Scholar query](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=slum+redevelopment+India+resident+outcomes) and [Semantic Scholar query](https://www.semanticscholar.org/search?q=Mumbai%20slum%20rehabilitation%20displacement%20livelihoods&sort=relevance) could not be retrieved. Publisher and institutional-repository discovery supplied the literature. No systematic search hit counts are claimed.
5. The PMC article copy at `https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3599692/` returned a browser-check page. No CAPTCHA was solved. The original publisher's full text was accessible instead.
6. No enabled browser tab/app surface was available for interactive portal testing. No government, resident, contractor or NGO was contacted.
7. The earlier staging-domain SBM guideline lead failed, and `https://sbmurban.org/storage/app/media/pdf/swachh-bharat-2.pdf` returned 404. Follow-up found the official DMA copy in O53 and read indexed Chapter 10, while full-file acquisition still failed. The old failures do not imply the guideline has no official accessible source.

## Primary method documentation

Read on 2026-10-17 for the original feasibility assessment: [QGIS 3.44 network analysis](https://docs.qgis.org/3.44/en/docs/user_manual/processing_algs/qgis/networkanalysis.html), [NetworkX shortest-path algorithms](https://networkx.org/documentation/stable/reference/algorithms/shortest_paths.html) and [OR-Tools mixed-integer example](https://developers.google.com/optimization/mip/mip_example). The later prototype implements deterministic browser-side graph/scoring/subset methods without requiring these packages; executed checks are recorded separately in [prototype_validation.md](prototype_validation.md).
